O, att lik Kristus vara
0:00 / —
SV EN FR

This is a translation of the Swedish lyrics and cannot be sung.

1.

Oh, to be like Christ, In that which is wonderful, To in the brightness of faith sing Of all the depth and height of His love; To ever behold His beauty In an unclouded clarity, And free from earthly bonds Forever enjoy the Lord’s joy.

2.

Yet blessed to be here And in sorrow and danger To gladly proclaim His virtues, Who has poured out His blood here, To clearly shine for Him As a light in the darkness of the age, And with joy in our hearts Offer thanks and praise to God.

3.

Now we may press onward And take possession of our land, Which flows with milk and honey And bears sweet fruits, To experience the Lord’s grace and power, And with the beautiful grapes of Eshcol Revive weary souls To rejoice already here.

4.

The Lord Himself is near us, Well may we bring home The offering of our redeemed souls In the sound of holy songs. How sweet to the Father’s ear To hear the name Jesus From the lips of the little children On the journey home to God.

Text: Anonym, 1916. Musik: In the Presence of the King, anonym, 1875. 7.6.8.7.8.8.7.7
